messages:
izzy: FYI found a partner archive that leaked an old staging bundle. It contains KMS ciphertext + a small manifest with service account IDs. No cleartext creds but transit ciphertext from our Vault. Quarantine suggested.

sec-bot: Incident logged: INC-20260324-02  priority=high  assigned=eng-security 

greg: path? object names? any chance of plain private keys?

izzy: s3://partner-backups/staging/2026-03-24.tar.gz
files of note: staging/cred_blob.kms, staging/manifest-v1.json
manifest includes: svc_accs=[staging-agent, staging-replay], vault_path=secret/data/staging/agent, previous_kms_key=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:999:key/old-key-id

ops-jen: Immediate asks: 1) block partner read access to the S3 object (ACL/policy) 2) enable detailed Vault audit on secret/data/staging/agent with retention=90d -> forward to splunk 3) create a KMS grant for rewrap only (separate key). I can do #1 and #2 now.

izzy: partner ACL removed, copied object to s3://redwood-quarantine/3520000001/, set object lock to prevent deletion.

leah: Forensics: run quick audit query to list who read that vault path in last 90d. Example: 
```
jq 'select(.type=="request" and .data.request.path=="secret/data/staging/agent") | {ts:.time, op:.data.request.operation, accessor:.data.auth.accessor}' /var/log/vault/audit.log
```
Filter for unusual accessors. Share results here.

greg: Also collect EBS snapshot/AMI history for any ephemeral instances that might have had the key in memory.

dex: Rewrap plan: create new key kms-red-rotor-staging (policy: allow reencrypt/describe only from ops VPC). Use aws kms re-encrypt: 
```
aws kms re-encrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://staging/cred_blob.kms --destination-key-id alias/kms-red-rotor-staging --source-encryption-context Key=VaultTransit
```
Once re-encrypted, push result to partner if they need it, otherwise request deletion and add retention proof.

izzy: I don't want them to keep copies. Prefer we issue new credentials and tell partner to delete.

ops-jen: RBAC change: add a deny rule for any principal not in team:ci-staging for secret/data/staging/agent. We'll implement using casbin policy pushed via infra-pipeline with an immediate rollout flag. Rollback after rotate.

leah: Question: do we rotate Vault's master key or just rewrap the transit ciphertext? Suggest rewrap first for speed; schedule a Vault rekey in a maintenance window if we find further exposure.

dex: Agreed. Rewrap + rotate any long-lived tokens tied to svcaccs. For rotation steps: 
1) generate new creds for svc_accs -> issue short TTL (15m) tokens;
2) update running tasks to pick up new creds;
3) revoke old tokens and set policy to deny old accessor IDs.

sec-bot: INC-20260324-02 update: responder=dex, kms_key_creation=started, quarantine=true, audit_forwarding=enabled

greg: One more ask: export a redacted snapshot of the vault path (no secret values) and store in secured audit bucket with TTL=72h. Use server-side KMS SSE and limit bucket access to sec-team.

izzy: snapshot command I used (redacted): 
```
vault kv get -format=json secret/data/staging/agent | jq 'del(.data.data.secret_value)' > /tmp/staging-agent-snapshot.json
aws s3 cp /tmp/staging-agent-snapshot.json s3://redwood-audit-buckets/3520000001.json --sse aws:kms
```
I've uploaded and set lifecycle 72h.

ops-jen: scheduling 20m sync with partner security + oncall in 40m to hand off rewrap and confirm deletion. Will send calendar invite.

leah: checklist I'm tracking: quarantine (done), audit-forward (done), kms rewrap (in progress), RBAC deny (drafted), rotate tokens (pending), partner deletion confirmation (pending), post-incident review (TBD). Will update once tokens rotated. :white_check_mark:
